competences.description: Bites your enemy and recovers 30% of the inflicted damage. Damage increases according to your Attack Speed.
Attacks the enemy and increases your Attack Speed for 2 turns. Damage increases according to your Attack Speed.

Increases your Attack Speed by 25, and increases your Attack Speed more as your HP status worsens. In addition, increases your Critical Rate by 30% when attacking enemies with lower Attack Speed than yours. [Automatic Effect]
